proposals.title: 34 shoppers asked for hypoallergenic studs
proposals.summary: Shoppers keep asking about sensitive ears and nickel, and 6 studs/huggies already mention titanium or surgical-steel posts in their descriptions, but none are tagged. Confirm the post material and launch a "Studs for sensitive ears" ad group.

evidence.label: Matching SKUs (unverified)
evidence.value: Classic Solitaire Stud Earrings, Classic Pearl Stud Earrings, Heart Stud Earrings, Mini Bezel Stud Earrings, Mini Huggie Earrings, Twisted Huggie Earrings

examples: new piercing, which studs are safe
will the huggie fit a second piercing
sensitive ears wale ke liye kya acha hai
is the post titanium or steel?
proposals.impact: New ad group; rail built from the newly tagged studs

proposals.title: Add "waterproof" to 18 SKUs
proposals.summary: 18 steel + PVD SKUs say "shower-proof" or "pool-safe" in their copy, but the water_resistant attribute is empty, so the agent can't claim it and the ad feed can't match waterproof queries.

evidence.label: SKUs with the claim only in prose
Example phrases
evidence.value: "Waterproof and 18K gold plated stainless steel." · "Waterproof and 18K gold plated stainless steel." · "Waterproof and 18K gold plated stainless steel."

examples: can my kid wear them in the pool
will the gold come off in water
proposals.impact: Waterproof rail and agent answers can include these SKUs once confirmed

Tangles every single time I take it off
